name: West Ivey projecting wall
summary: Narrow, flat-capped projection positioned between the low west pavilions of the Richard Ivey Building.

evidence.note: City of London 2025 orthophoto. Narrow capped strip with a long shadow between two wider Ivey roofs. Paving continues beyond its west end. No separate enclosed building is apparent.
Inventory P50 3.23 m, P90 3.89 m, maximum 4.23 m. Strip median 3.23 m, P90 3.89 m and maximum 4.23 m, below the neighbouring pavilion.
Campus frame search out to 130 m found no usable street-facing image. Finish and bay estimates on screened walls are provisional.

notes: Treat this strip as a wall-like Ivey projection. Aerial imagery does not resolve whether the cap spans a passage, and blocky stone is inferred from the immediately adjoining pavilions.
